intro: Deliana is looking for a way to speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon. An engineer with a peculiar fascination for the supernatural says he can build a machine for talking to the dead, and you bring him the blood you collected, in Gadgetzan, as his payment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I must find a way to speak with Anthion Harmon... Or more specifically, his ghost!
I know of an engineer with a queer interest in the supernatural. He claims he can build a machine that allows him to speak with the dead!
The blood you collected was intended for him; travel to Gadgetzan and bring it to him as payment for his services!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent! Just as I was running low!
